objective: Improve L-DAMP channel recovery and computational utility using estimated channel structure, then independently validate the selected candidate.
stages: Check complex projection and complete derivative against independent SVD/autograd and finite differences
Compare original, final-only projection and recurrent projection on six old conditions
Calibrate selected frozen receiver on eight old development scenes; retain failed alternatives
Freeze selected implementation and threshold before generating ten new scenes at six SNRs
Evaluate full/active/inactive errors, misses, false alarms, runtime and paired scene uncertainty; review exact results before adoption
selection_rule: Select only on development evidence; prioritize a clear full-channel gain without material runtime growth, preserve all regressions; new test results never select weights, threshold, recurrence or iteration budget.
limits: Zero intra-user path direction spread; rank-one physical channel does not imply rank-one posterior mean
Training and inference mismatch of the frozen neural denoiser is not claimed solved by structural projection
No state-evolution or convergence claim for AFDM
implementation_boundary: Existing src and default models/configuration unchanged; experimental wrappers use frozen public receiver.
completion_note: All planned stages executed. Output TSVD improves the channel estimate; recalibrated activity rule fails to improve new-scene detection. Both rules and all development alternatives retained; public default uses the prespecified original-decision control. No test-driven parameter retuning.
